jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

Postdoctoral Researcher on CO2 Solid Adsorbent Shaping and Degradation

The Laboratory for Building Energy Materials and Components develops advanced and/or low eco-impact, porous materials for insulation, sorption, and energy-related applications. Our research portfolio spans fundamental materials chemistry, process–structure–property relationships, and application-driven R&D, in close collaboration with academic and industrial partners.

To strengthen our team, we are seeking a highly motivated researcher with a strong background in solid adsorbents/gas adsorption/separation.

Project Focus
 The project builds on Empa’s expertise in the field of sorbents and carbon capture. The position is part of the National Center of Competence in Research (NCCR) "Separations", a collaborative project lead by EPFL (Prof. Wendy Queen) and further involving ETH Zurich, University of Fribourg, HES-SO, Northwestern University (USA) and University of Alberta (Canada).

The NCCR focuses on three key challenges:

• CO2 capture from air: Developing scalable, cost-effective processes to efficiently remove atmospheric CO2.

• High-temperature ammonia separation: Creating novel high temperature separation technologies to make ammonia synthesis significantly more energy-efficient.

• Recovery of critical metals: Developing processes to recover valuable metals such as lithium and cobalt from waste streams, enabling secure and sustainable material cycles.

Your tasks

As part of the NCCR-Network, you will contribute to the project aims in the areas of shaped CO2 adsorbents and sorbent ageing. Within the framework of the NCCR project with well-defined objectives, you will be encouraged to develop independent ideas, propose new concepts, and test them experimentally and/or computationally. The role is ideally suited to strengthen your pre-existing expertise and enhance your academic track record.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Help coordinate project activities and develop synergies within the team and between project partners.

• Supervise intern students contributing to the project.

• Elucidate chemical as well as structural ageing mechanisms of structured and pure solid sorbents under different ageing conditions.

• Develop accelerated and high throughput sorbent ageing protocols.

• Help define mitigation strategies for sorbent ageing.

• Develop versatile, upscalable sorbent shaping/coating procedures.

• Help shape new, emerging scientific research lines within the project scope and publish/communicate your scientific results

Your profile

• A high level of curiosity, independence, teamwork skills and motivation

• Doctoral degree or equivalent research experience in porous materials, surface or adsorption/separation science or a closely related field

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English

Experience or familiarity with one of the following topics:

• Characterization of sorbent/porous materials characterization e.g. nitrogen sorption (BET, BJH, NLDFT), breakthrough measurements, SEM, TEM, TGA, FTIR, NMR, thermal conductivity measurements

• Synthesis and/or shaping of solid sorbents.

• Sorbent modelling and prediction of performance or ageing.

Our offer

We offer a stimulating, international, and collaborative research environment at a leading research institution with state-of-the-art infrastructure. The laboratory and supervisors provide a supportive and safe-to-fail work environment. As part of the ETH Domain, we offer attractive employment conditions and excellent opportunities for professional and personal development. Start date is upon agreement for a duration of 2 years.

We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

• Supervise studenti tirocinanti che contribuiscono al progetto.
• Elucidi i meccanismi di invecchiamento chimico e strutturale di sorbenti solidi strutturati e puri in diverse condizioni di invecchiamento.
• Sviluppare protocolli di invecchiamento sorbenti accelerati e ad alto rendimento.
• Aiuta a definire strategie di mitigazione per l'invecchiamento sorbente.
• Sviluppare procedure di modellazione/coating sorbent versatili e scalabili.
• Aiuta a modellare nuove linee di ricerca scientifiche emergenti nell'ambito del progetto e pubblicare/comunicare i risultati scientifici Il tuo profilo
• Un alto livello di curiosità, indipendenza, abilità di lavoro di squadra e motivazione
• Grado medico o esperienza di ricerca equivalente in materiali porosi, superficie o adsorbimento/separazione scienza o un campo strettamente correlato
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale in inglese Esperienza o familiarità con uno dei seguenti argomenti:
• Caratterizzazione di materiali sorbenti/porosi caratterizzazione come ad esempio l'assorbimento di azoto (BET, BJH, NLDFT), misurazioni innovative, SEM, TEM, TGA, FTIR, NMR, misurazioni di conducibilità termica
• Sintesi e/o sagomatura di solidi sorbenti.

La nostra offerta Offriamo un ambiente di ricerca stimolante, internazionale e collaborativo in un istituto di ricerca leader con infrastrutture all'avanguardia. Il laboratorio e i supervisori forniscono un ambiente di lavoro solidale e sicuro. Come parte del Dominio ETH, offriamo condizioni di lavoro attraenti e ottime opportunità per lo sviluppo professionale e personale. La data di inizio è su accordo per una durata di 2 anni. Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Diamo il benvenuto a tutte le persone che sono interessate a attività innovative, sostenibili e significative - questo è ciò che conta. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online completa, tra cui una lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati, diplomi e dettagli di contatto di due persone di riferimento. Si prega di inviare questi esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale di lavoro. Le domande per e-mail e per posta non saranno considerate.

Die Empa ist eine Forschungseinrichtung des ETH-Bereichs. Postdoktorandin zum Thema CO2 Solid Adsorbent Shaping and Degradation Das Laboratory for Building Energy Materials and Components entwickelt fortschrittliche und/oder umweltfreundliche, poröse Materialien für Isolations-, Sorptions- und energiebezogene Anwendungen. Unser Forschungsportfolio umfasst grundlegende Materialchemie, Prozess-Struktur-Eigenschaftsbeziehungen und anwendungsorientierte Forschung und Entwicklung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit akademischen und industriellen Partnern. Um unser Team zu stärken, suchen wir einen hochmotivierten Forscher mit einem starken Hintergrund in festen Adsorbentien / Gasadsorption / Trennung. Projektschwerpunkt Das Projekt baut auf der Expertise der Empa im Bereich Sorbentien und Kohlenstoffabscheidung auf. Die Position ist Teil des National Center of Competence in Research (NCCR) "Separations", einem Verbundprojekt unter der Leitung der EPFL (Prof. Wendy Queen) und weiter unter Beteiligung der ETH Zürich, Universität Freiburg, HES-SO, Northwestern University (USA) und University of Alberta (Kanada). Der NFS konzentriert sich auf drei zentrale Herausforderungen:
• CO2-Abscheidung aus der Luft: Entwicklung skalierbarer, kostengünstiger Prozesse zur effizienten Entfernung von atmosphärischem CO2.
• Hochtemperatur-Ammoniak-Trennung: Entwicklung neuartiger Hochtemperatur-Trenntechnologien, um die Ammoniaksynthese deutlich energieeffizienter zu gestalten.
• Rückgewinnung kritischer Metalle: Entwicklung von Prozessen zur Rückgewinnung wertvoller Metalle wie Lithium und Kobalt aus Abfallströmen, die sichere und nachhaltige Stoffkreisläufe ermöglichen. Ihre Aufgaben Im Rahmen des NFS-Netzwerks tragen Sie zu den Projektzielen in den Bereichen geformte CO2-Adsorbentien und Sorbensalterung bei. Die Rolle ist ideal geeignet, um Ihre bereits bestehende Expertise zu stärken und Ihre akademische Erfolgsbilanz zu verbessern. Ihre Aufgaben umfassen:

• Chemische sowie strukturelle Alterungsmechanismen von strukturierten und reinen festen Sorbentien unter verschiedenen Alterungsbedingungen aufklären.
• Entwicklung beschleunigter und hochdurchsatzfähiger Sorbensalterungsprotokolle.
• Helfen Sie bei der Definition von Minderungsstrategien für das Altern von Sorbenten.
• Entwicklung vielseitiger, hochskalierbarer Verfahren zur Formgebung/Beschichtung von Sorbentien.
• Helfen Sie, neue, aufkommende wissenschaftliche Forschungslinien innerhalb des Projektumfangs zu gestalten und veröffentlichen / kommunizieren Sie Ihre wissenschaftlichen Ergebnisse Dein Profil

descriptionByLocale.fr:
La science et la technologie des matériaux sont notre passion. Grâce à nos recherches de pointe, les quelque 1 100 employés d'Empa apportent une contribution essentielle au bien-être de la société pour un avenir digne d'être vécu. Empa est une institution de recherche du domaine ETH. Chercheur postdoctoral sur la formation et la dégradation des adsorbants solides de CO2 Le Laboratoire des matériaux et composants énergétiques du bâtiment développe des matériaux d'isolation, de sorption et d'utilisation liés à l'énergie, de pointe ou à faible impact environnemental. Notre portefeuille de recherche couvre la chimie fondamentale des matériaux, les relations entre les processus et la propriété et la R-D axée sur les applications, en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires universitaires et industriels. Pour renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons un chercheur hautement motivé ayant une solide expérience en adsorbants solides/adsorption/séparation de gaz. Objectif du projet Le projet s'appuie sur l'expertise d'Empa dans le domaine des sorbants et du captage du carbone. Ce poste fait partie du National Center of Competence in Research (NCCR) "Separations", un projet collaboratif dirigé par l'EPFL (Prof. Wendy Queen) et auquel participent également l'ETH Zurich, l'Université de Fribourg, HES-SO, l'Université du Nord-Ouest (USA) et l'Université de l'Alberta (Canada). Le CCNR se concentre sur trois défis clés :
• Capture de CO2 dans l'air : Mettre au point des processus évolutifs et rentables pour éliminer efficacement le CO2 atmosphérique.
• Séparation à haute température de l'ammoniac: Création de nouvelles technologies de séparation à haute température pour rendre la synthèse de l'ammoniac significativement plus économe en énergie.
• Récupération des métaux essentiels : Mettre au point des processus pour récupérer des métaux précieux tels que le lithium et le cobalt dans les flux de déchets, permettant des cycles de matières sûrs et durables. Vos tâches Dans le cadre du réseau NCCR, vous contribuerez aux objectifs du projet dans les domaines des adsorbants en forme de CO2 et du vieillissement sorbant. Dans le cadre du projet du CCNR avec des objectifs bien définis, vous serez encouragé à développer des idées indépendantes, à proposer de nouveaux concepts et à les tester expérimentalement et/ou par calcul. Le rôle est idéal pour renforcer votre expertise préexistante et améliorer votre expérience académique. Vos responsabilités comprendront :
• Aider à coordonner les activités du projet et à développer des synergies au sein de l'équipe et entre les partenaires du projet.
• Superviser les étudiants stagiaires qui contribuent au projet.
• Élucidate chimique ainsi que les mécanismes de vieillissement structurel des sorbants solides structurés et purs dans différentes conditions de vieillissement.
• Élaborer des protocoles de vieillissement sorbant à débit accéléré et élevé.
• Aider à définir des stratégies d'atténuation du vieillissement sorbant.
• Développer des procédures polyvalentes et évolutives de façonnage et de revêtement des sorbants.
• Aider à façonner les nouvelles lignes de recherche scientifique dans le cadre du projet et publier/communiquer vos résultats scientifiques Votre profil
• Un haut niveau de curiosité, d'indépendance, d'esprit d'équipe et de motivation
• Diplôme de doctorat ou expérience de recherche équivalente en matériaux poreux, en sciences de surface ou d'adsorption/séparation ou dans un domaine étroitement lié
• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale en anglais Expérience ou connaissance de l'un des sujets suivants :
• Caractérisation de la caractérisation des matériaux sorbants/poreux, p.ex. sorption d'azote (BET, BJH, NLDFT), mesures de rupture, SEM, TEM, TGA, FTIR, RMN, mesures de conductivité thermique
• Synthèse et/ou mise en forme des sorbants solides.
• Modélisation et prédiction des performances ou du vieillissement. Notre offre Nous offrons un environnement de recherche stimulant, international et collaboratif dans un établissement de recherche de premier plan doté d'une infrastructure de pointe. Le laboratoire et les superviseurs offrent un milieu de travail favorable et sécuritaire. Dans le domaine de l'ETH, nous offrons des conditions d'emploi attrayantes et d'excellentes possibilités de développement professionnel et personnel. La date de début est convenue pour une durée de 2 ans. Nous vivons une culture d'inclusion et de respect. Nous accueillons toutes les personnes qui s'intéressent à des activités novatrices, durables et significatives - c'est ce qui compte. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature en ligne complète comprenant une lettre de motivation, CV, certificats, diplômes et coordonnées de deux personnes de référence. Veuillez les soumettre exclusivement via notre portail d'emploi. Les demandes par courrier électronique et par la poste ne seront pas prises en considération.

jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

Postdoc position in CO2 electrocatalysis under realistic conditions

Empa’s Laboratory Materials for Energy Conversion focuses on materials and device innovation for sustainable energy conversion and storage technologies.

Your tasks

The research project focuses on understanding the electrocatalytic conversion of CO2 into sustainable products. Your task will include:

• Assemble and validate modular electrocatalytic reactors and analysis methods for realistic CO2 electrocatalysis, with a focus on parallel investigations and accelerated aging.

• Dissect degradation processes of CO2 electroreduction catalyst, electrodes, and ionomer membranes under diverse real-world operating conditions, using operando electrochemical and spectroscopic methods.

• Lead synchrotron campaigns aiming at unveiling the degradation mechanism of catalysts, electrodes, and ionomer membranes with high time resolution, operando x-ray measurements.

• Develop electrode architecture and catalyst/electrode modification strategies for enhanced durability, using different fabrication methods.

This postdoc position is part of an international collaborative project involving several academic and industrial partners.

Your profile

We are looking for a highly motivated team player who thrives in a collaborative and interdisciplinary research environment. The ideal candidate possesses a PhD degree in chemistry or chemical engineering, materials science, physics, or related discipline. As this project is a cutting-edge research activity beyond the current state-of-the-art in electrocatalysis, we are looking for someone creative, curious, highly motivated, and with excellent problem-solving and technical skills. Prior experience in electrochemistry and/or catalysis is a strong advantage. The successful candidate will be expected to work independently in the lab while collaborating and communicating effectively with our multidisciplinary team.

Our offer

You will join a dynamic young international research group working in a brand new laboratory building located at Empa’s campus in Dübendorf near downtown Zürich. In addition to our state-of-the-art electrocatalysis facilities encompassing catalyst and electrode synthesis, parallel electrochemical characterizations and comprehensive gas and liquid analytics, the lab owns and operates a large array of instruments including X-ray diffractometers, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, infrared and Raman spectrometers, and argon ion mills and electron microscopes. The position is closely connected to two national research initiatives focusing on the synthesis of sustainable fuels and chemicals providing many opportunities to interact with a large and high-profile network that includes members of both academia and industry.

Empa is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strongly encourage applications from female researchers and individuals from underrepresented backgrounds. We believe diversity drives innovation and scientific excellence. Join us in contributing to groundbreaking research in sustainable energy technologies!

We look forward to receiving your online application including a two-page motivation letter, CV, scholarly records, diplomas with transcripts, and at least two reference letters. Only complete applications will be considered. Please upload all documents through our webpage, applications via E-mail cannot be accepted.

Il candidato di successo lavorerà in modo indipendente in laboratorio, collaborando e comunicando efficacemente con il nostro team multidisciplinare. La nostra offerta Vi unirete a un dinamico gruppo di ricerca internazionale che lavora in un nuovo edificio di laboratorio situato nel campus di Empa a Dübendorf vicino al centro di Zurigo. Oltre ai nostri impianti di elettrocatalisi all'avanguardia che comprendono catalizzatore e sintesi elettrodi, caratterizzazioni elettrochimiche parallele e analisi complete del gas e del liquido, il laboratorio possiede e gestisce una vasta gamma di strumenti tra cui diffrattometri a raggi X, spettroscopia a raggi X, spettrometri a raggi infrarossi e Raman, mulini a ioni argon e microscopi elettroni. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda online, tra cui una lettera di motivazione di due pagine, CV, record accademici, diplomi con trascrizioni, e almeno due lettere di riferimento. Saranno considerate solo le applicazioni complete. Si prega di caricare tutti i documenti attraverso la nostra pagina web, le applicazioni via E-mail non possono essere accettate.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

Postdoc position in CO2 electrocatalysis under realistic conditions

Empa’s Laboratory Materials for Energy Conversion focuses on materials and device innovation for sustainable energy conversion and storage technologies.

Your tasks

The research project focuses on understanding the electrocatalytic conversion of CO2 into sustainable products. Your task will include:

• Assemble and validate modular electrocatalytic reactors and analysis methods for realistic CO2 electrocatalysis, with a focus on parallel investigations and accelerated aging.

• Dissect degradation processes of CO2 electroreduction catalyst, electrodes, and ionomer membranes under diverse real-world operating conditions, using operando electrochemical and spectroscopic methods.

• Lead synchrotron campaigns aiming at unveiling the degradation mechanism of catalysts, electrodes, and ionomer membranes with high time resolution, operando x-ray measurements.

• Develop electrode architecture and catalyst/electrode modification strategies for enhanced durability, using different fabrication methods.

This postdoc position is part of an international collaborative project involving several academic and industrial partners.

Your profile

We are looking for a highly motivated team player who thrives in a collaborative and interdisciplinary research environment. The ideal candidate possesses a PhD degree in chemistry or chemical engineering, materials science, physics, or related discipline. As this project is a cutting-edge research activity beyond the current state-of-the-art in electrocatalysis, we are looking for someone creative, curious, highly motivated, and with excellent problem-solving and technical skills. Prior experience in electrochemistry and/or catalysis is a strong advantage. The successful candidate will be expected to work independently in the lab while collaborating and communicating effectively with our multidisciplinary team.

Our offer

You will join a dynamic young international research group working in a brand new laboratory building located at Empa’s campus in Dübendorf near downtown Zürich. In addition to our state-of-the-art electrocatalysis facilities encompassing catalyst and electrode synthesis, parallel electrochemical characterizations and comprehensive gas and liquid analytics, the lab owns and operates a large array of instruments including X-ray diffractometers, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, infrared and Raman spectrometers, and argon ion mills and electron microscopes. The position is closely connected to two national research initiatives focusing on the synthesis of sustainable fuels and chemicals providing many opportunities to interact with a large and high-profile network that includes members of both academia and industry.

Empa is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strongly encourage applications from female researchers and individuals from underrepresented backgrounds. We believe diversity drives innovation and scientific excellence. Join us in contributing to groundbreaking research in sustainable energy technologies!

We look forward to receiving your online application including a two-page motivation letter, CV, scholarly records, diplomas with transcripts, and at least two reference letters. Only complete applications will be considered. Please upload all documents through our webpage, applications via E-mail cannot be accepted.

Ihre Aufgaben Das Forschungsprojekt konzentriert sich auf das Verständnis der elektrokatalytischen Umwandlung von CO2 in nachhaltige Produkte. Ihre Aufgabe umfasst:
• Bauen und validieren Sie modulare elektrokatalytische Reaktoren und Analysemethoden für eine realistische CO2-Elektrokatalyse mit Schwerpunkt auf parallelen Untersuchungen und beschleunigter Alterung.
• Zerlegungsprozesse von CO2-Elektroreduktionskatalysatoren, Elektroden und Ionomermembranen unter verschiedenen realen Betriebsbedingungen mit elektrochemischen und spektroskopischen Methoden.
• Führen Sie Synchrotronkampagnen, die darauf abzielen, den Abbaumechanismus von Katalysatoren, Elektroden und Ionomermembranen mit hoher Zeitauflösung, Operando-Röntgenmessungen, zu enthüllen.

Empa est une institution de recherche du domaine ETH. Position postdoc dans l'électrocatalyse CO2 dans des conditions réalistes Les matériaux de laboratoire pour la conversion de l'énergie sont axés sur l'innovation des matériaux et des appareils pour des technologies de conversion et de stockage durables de l'énergie. Vos tâches Le projet de recherche vise à comprendre la conversion électrocatalytique du CO2 en produits durables. Votre tâche comprendra :
• Assembler et valider des réacteurs électrocatalytiques modulaires et des méthodes d'analyse pour l'électrocatalyse réaliste du CO2, en mettant l'accent sur les enquêtes parallèles et le vieillissement accéléré.
• Disséquer les processus de dégradation du catalyseur d'électroréduction du CO2, des électrodes et des membranes d'ionomères dans diverses conditions d'exploitation réelles, en utilisant des méthodes électrochimiques et spectroscopiques.
• Campagnes de synchrotrons de plomb visant à dévoiler le mécanisme de dégradation des catalyseurs, des électrodes et des membranes ionomères à haute résolution temporelle, mesures par rayons X d'opérando.
• Développer l'architecture des électrodes et des stratégies de modification des catalyseurs/électrodes pour une durabilité accrue, en utilisant différentes méthodes de fabrication. Ce poste postdoc fait partie d'un projet de collaboration internationale impliquant plusieurs partenaires académiques et industriels. Comme ce projet est une activité de recherche de pointe au-delà de l'état actuel de l'électrocatalyse, nous sommes à la recherche de quelqu'un de créatif, curieux, très motivé, et avec d'excellentes compétences techniques et de résolution de problèmes. L'expérience antérieure en électrochimie et/ou en catalyse est un avantage important. En plus de nos installations d'électrocatalyse de pointe comprenant la synthèse des catalyseurs et des électrodes, les caractérisations électrochimiques parallèles et l'analyse complète des gaz et des liquides, le laboratoire possède et exploite une vaste gamme d'instruments, dont les diffractomètres à rayons X, la spectroscopie par photoélectrons à rayons X, les spectromètres infrarouges et Raman, ainsi que les argon-ions et les microscopes électroniques. La position est étroitement liée à deux initiatives nationales de recherche axées sur la synthèse de combustibles et de produits chimiques durables, offrant de nombreuses possibilités d'interagir avec un réseau de grande envergure qui comprend des membres du milieu universitaire et de l'industrie. Seules les demandes complètes seront examinées. Veuillez télécharger tous les documents via notre page Web, les applications par e-mail ne peuvent pas être acceptées.

• Fertigung von Werkstücken und Anlagen für die Forschungs- und Prüfanlagen

• Drehen, Bohren und Fräsen von Metallen und Kunststoffen mit konventionellen und CNC-Maschinen

• Montieren von Baugruppen

• Programmieren von Werkstücken auf moderner CAD/CAM Software

Dein Profil

Dein Sekundarabschluss ist in greifbarer Nähe und du hast gute Leistungen (Sek A) bis sehr gute Leistungen (Sek B) in den Fächern Arithmetik/Algebra sowie Geometrie, Physik und Deutsch. Hohes Verantwortungsgefühl und Teamfähigkeit sind weitere wichtige Komponenten.

Während der Lehre produzierst du verschiedene Prototypen und Einzelteile und hast so die Möglichkeit, dir ein vielfältiges Wissen anzueignen. descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

La scienza e la tecnologia dei materiali sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca all'avanguardia, i circa 1.100 dipendenti di Empa danno contributi decisivi al benessere della società per un futuro degno di essere vissuto. Empa è un istituto di ricerca del dominio ETH.

Apprendista polimeccanico (a)

Una formazione professionale ampia, ben fondata e variegata è una preoccupazione centrale per noi. Tuttavia, con un apprendistato in ricerca, vorremmo insegnarti non solo il mestiere puramente professionale, ma anche goderti il tuo lavoro. A tal fine, ti offriamo l'opportunità di svolgere tirocini con i nostri partner industriali durante il tuo apprendistato per ampliare significativamente la tua esperienza esperita.

I prerequisiti fondamentali per una formazione professionale di successo presso Empa sono motivazione, entusiasmo e flessibilità, oltre a un certo grado di autodisciplina. Valori come indipendenza, senso di responsabilità, creatività, orientamento al cliente e la capacità di pensare avanti, avanti e avanti ti accompagneranno durante tutta la tua formazione con noi. Ti supporteremo anche con "Saphir", il nostro concetto interno per supportare gli apprendisti. Se l'idea di lavorare in un ambiente di ricerca sul futuro di tutti noi ti entusiasma e motiva, non vediamo l'ora di conoscerti.

Responsabilità

- Produzione di pezzi di lavoro e sistemi per strutture di ricerca e test
- Tornitura, foratura e fresatura di metalli e plastiche con macchine convenzionali e CNC
- Assemblaggio delle assemblee
- Sviluppo di soluzioni progettuali di piccole dimensioni e creazione di disegni tecnici
- Programmazione di pezzi su software CAD/CAM moderno

Il tuo profilo

- Il diploma di scuola secondaria è a portata di mano e hai buoni voti (Sek A) fino a voti molto validi (Sek B) nelle materie di Aritmetica/Algebra così come Geometria, Fisica e Tedesco.
- La tua ottima immaginazione spaziale è accompagnata dalla volontà di imparare e esibirti e, naturalmente, ti piace lavorare con metalli e plastiche.
- Richiediamo un grande interesse per le macchine moderne e complesse, oltre a un talento per il lavoro preciso e veloce.
- Un alto senso di responsabilità e la capacità di lavorare in squadra sono altri elementi importanti.

La nostra offerta

- Offriamo una solida formazione tecnica con macchine e utensili moderni.
- Durante l'apprendistato, produrrà vari prototipi e singoli pezzi e avrà così l'opportunità di acquisire una vasta gamma di conoscenze.
- Empa è un ambiente di ricerca vivace e innovativo con un carattere internazionale e ottime condizioni di lavoro nell'agglomerato di Zurigo.

Puoi trovare maggiori informazioni sugli insegnamenti di Empa nel nostro foglio informativo.

Contattaci ora

Ti abbiamo già contattato? Allora inviaci la tua domanda oggi, non vediamo l'ora di sentirti.

"A" sta per "tutti" nei nostri annunci di lavoro. Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Accogliamo con favore tutte le persone interessate ad attività innovative, sostenibili e significative - è l'unica cosa che conta.

Attendiamo con interesse la tua candidatura online completa, inclusa lettera di presentazione, CV, relazioni scolastiche, test e rapporti di degustazione tramite cassa di segnalazione. Ti preghiamo di inviarli esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale di candidatura. Le domande via e-mail o posta non saranno considerate.

Description

Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's approximately 1,100 employees make decisive contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

Apprentice polymechanic (a)

Broad, well-founded and varied vocational training is a central concern for us. However, with an apprenticeship in research, we would like to teach you not only the pure professional trade, but also enjoy your work. To this end, we offer you the opportunity to do internships with our industrial partners during your apprenticeship in order to significantly expand your wealth of experience.

The basic prerequisites for successful vocational training at Empa are motivation, enthusiasm and flexibility, as well as a certain degree of self-discipline. Values such as independence, a sense of responsibility, creativity, customer orientation and the ability to think ahead, ahead and ahead will accompany you throughout your training with us. We will also support you with "Saphir", our in-house concept for supporting apprentices. If the thought of working in a research environment on the future of all of us excites and motivates you, we look forward to getting to know you.

Responsibilities

- Production of workpieces and systems for research and testing facilities
- Turning, drilling and milling of metals and plastics with conventional and CNC machines
- Assembly of assemblies
- Developing small design solutions and creating technical drawings
- Programming of workpieces on modern CAD/CAM software

Your profile

- Your secondary school diploma is within reach and you have good grades (Sek A) to very good grades (Sek B) in the subjects Arithmetic/Algebra as well as Geometry, Physics and German.
- Your very good spatial imagination is paired with a willingness to learn and perform and, of course, you enjoy working with metals and plastics.
- We require a great interest in modern, complex machines as well as a talent for precise and speedy work.
- A high sense of responsibility and the ability to work in a team are other important components.

Our offer

- We offer a solid technical education with modern machines and tools.
- During the apprenticeship, you will produce various prototypes and individual parts and thus have the opportunity to acquire a wide range of knowledge.
- Empa is a lively and innovative research environment with an international flair and excellent employment conditions in the Zurich agglomeration.

You can find more information about Empa's teachings in our factsheet .

Contact Now

Have we approached you? Then send us your application today, we look forward to hearing from you.

"a" stands for "all" in our job advertisements. We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's the only thing that counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including cover letter, CV, school reports, signal box test and taster reports. Please submit them exclusively via our application portal. Applications by e-mail or post will not be considered.

- Interesse per lavori fisici vari sia al chiuso che all'esterno

In our fascinating research environment, we are offering an apprenticeship position as of August 2027.

"a" stands for "all" in our job advertisements. We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's the only thing that counts.

Contact Now

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit them exclusively via our application portal. Applications by e-mail or post will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

Postdoc/Engineer in acoustics for laser processing (80-100%)

The Laboratory of Advanced Materials Processing (LAMP) is a multidisciplinary research unit that develops innovative functional modification of materials by beam (e.g. laser light, electrons) and plasma induced processing. LAMP provides full cycle technology development, starting from novel materials, deep understanding of the background physics of beam-matter interactions, development of automated AI/ML systems for novel materials processing and quality insurance. The lab combines additive manufacturing, large scale laser micro-processing, multiscale modelling and AI/ML for the quality monitoring/control, at the end offering to the society novel nanostructured materials, their shape-forming and integration into devices.

Your tasks

• R&D of acoustic system (acoustics/multi-physics simulation, experimental planning, setup, measurements, analysis)

• Conceptualization and realization of novel setups (hardware integration, CAD design, assembly, etc.)

• Software development (data acquisition and processing, system communication)

Your profile

• FH/University degree (Master or PhD) Acoustics/Electronics/Engineering or equivalent

• Experience: Acoustics (active, passive), laser processing

• Skills: R&D manufacturing, software development (machine communication, data acquisition, etc.), hardware integration

• English, French and German as a plus

Our offer

Empa offers a dynamic and inspiring research environment at its Thun campus, located near Bern. You will work on a scientifically and technologically cutting-edge topic of high relevance and novelty, with direct access to state-of-the-art research infrastructure and equipment. As part of an experienced and multidisciplinary project team with strong national and international collaborations, you will receive full support in advancing the current project as well as in shaping and realizing your own scientific ideas within the lab's research activities. You will be encouraged and supported in producing high-impact results, publishing in leading international peer-reviewed journals, and pursuing your personal and professional development. The position is available with a starting date in September 2026 and a duration of one year with the possibility of extension.

We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

Lernende/r Physiklaborant/in (a)

Für August 2027 bieten wir in der Abteilung Werkstoff- und Nanomechanik in Thun einen anspruchsvollen Ausbildungsplatz in einem faszinierenden Forschungsumfeld.

Was erwartet dich

An einem ETH Forschungsinstitut tätig zu sein, bringt viel Abwechslung in den Berufsalltag. Wenn du Interesse an Physik, Elektronik, Technik und Werkstoffen hast, garantieren wir dir spannende Aufgaben in einem internationalen Umfeld der Forschung. Zudem liebst du das Tüfteln und Werken.

• Sekundarschule A mit sehr guten Leistungen in den naturwissenschaftlichen, mathematischen und sprachlichen Fächern - Englisch ist bei uns Alltagssprache

• Theoretisches und praktisches Interesse für Physik, Chemie, Werkstoffe, Elektronik sowie Informatik und an technischen Systemen

• Abstraktes Denken und methodisches Vorgehen, technisches Verständnis und manuelle Geschicklichkeit

• Gute Beobachtungs- und Auffassungsgabe, Sorgfalt, verantwortungsvolles und zuverlässiges Arbeiten

Formazione in laboratorio di fisica (a)

Per l'agosto 2027 offriamo un luogo di allenamento impegnativo in un ambiente di ricerca affascinante nel dipartimento Materiali e Nanomechanics a Thun.

Che cosa ti aspetta

Lavorare in un istituto di ricerca ETH porta molta varietà al vostro lavoro quotidiano. Se siete interessati a fisica, elettronica, tecnologia e materiali, vi garantiamo compiti entusiasmanti in un ambiente di ricerca internazionale. Amate anche tinkering e lavori.

Cosa porti con te?

• Scuola secondaria A con prestazioni molto buone nelle materie scientifiche, matematiche e linguistiche - l'inglese è la nostra lingua quotidiana

• Interesse teorico e pratico in fisica, chimica, materiali, elettronica, informatica e sistemi tecnici

• Pensiero astratto e approccio metodico, comprensione tecnica e abilità manuale

• Buon monitoraggio e comprensione, cura, lavoro responsabile e affidabile

• Godere di un ambiente di lavoro altamente tecnico e complesso

• Alte competenze in materia di comunicazione e cooperazione con le persone Siete anche convinti che inizierete il vostro futuro con un apprendistato professionale.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Esaminerete l'integrità fisica e chimica dei materiali metallici e dei loro componenti, come quelli utilizzati in edifici, ponti, gallerie, impianti di produzione, ingegneria meccanica, energia, tecnologie ferroviarie e mediche

• È possibile determinare le caratteristiche del materiale utilizzando i metodi analitici più moderni ed eseguire misurazioni fisiche e serie di test con materiali e sistemi

• Progetterà, preparerà, eseguirà e documenta le attrezzature di prova

• Visitate la scuola professionale di Zurigo. Il BMS è supportato. Offriamo una formazione di base emozionante e di base di versatile con la tecnologia più moderna. Si prega di inviarli esclusivamente attraverso il nostro portale di applicazione. Le domande per e-mail e per posta non saranno prese in considerazione.

Trainee in physics laboratory (a)

For August 2027, we offer a challenging training place in a fascinating research environment in the Materials and Nanomechanics department in Thun.

What awaits you

Working at an ETH research institute brings a lot of variety to your everyday work. If you are interested in physics, electronics, technology and materials, we guarantee you exciting tasks in an international research environment. You also love tinkering and works.

What do you bring with you?

• Secondary school A with very good performance in the scientific, mathematical and linguistic subjects - English is our everyday language

• Theoretical and practical interest in physics, chemistry, materials, electronics, computer science and technical systems

• Abstract thinking and methodical approach, technical understanding and manual skill

• Good monitoring and understanding, care, responsible and reliable work

• Enjoying a highly technical and complex working environment

• High skills in communication and cooperation with people You are also convinced that you will start your future with a professional apprenticeship.

What we offer you

• You will examine the physical and chemical integrity of metallic materials and their components, such as those used in buildings, bridges, tunnels, production plants, mechanical engineering, energy, railway and medical technology

• You will design, prepare, perform and document test equipment

• You are visiting the vocational school in Zurich. BMS is supported. We offer an exciting and versatile basic training with the most modern technology. Empa is a lively and innovative research environment with an international flair and excellent employment conditions in the Agglomeration of Zurich.

"a" stands for "all" in our job listings. We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are in the mood for innovative, sustainable and sun-drenched activities – that's all that counts.

We look forward to your complete online application including motivational letters, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit them exclusively via our application portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be taken into account.

jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

System-Engineer Cell Culture Automation 80 - 100%

The Nanomaterials in Health department at Empa St. Gallen is a highly motivated team of biologists, chemists and bioinformaticians. Our aim is understanding and controlling the interactions between (nano)materials and biological systems. To this end, we develop practical, clinically and diagnostically relevant cell-based models such as co-cultures and organoids.

Your tasks

As a specialist in cell culture automation, you will be responsible for the end-to-end development and maintenance of complex cell cultures, from concept to implementation. Specifically, this includes:
• Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to develop concepts for automating complex cell culture processes using robotics

• Conduct needs analyses to define the required system specifications and functional requirements

• Support the Laboratory Head in evaluating, comparing and selecting suitable robotic systems and assist throughout the procurement process

• Lead the implementation of the selected system, including its configuration and the programming of automated workflows and procedures

Your profile

• Master’s degree in life sciences, engineering, or equivalent education

• At least 3 years of professional experience in programming and operating laboratory automation and liquid-handling systems, as well as in related quality management

• Experience in adapting and optimizing cell-based and in vitro assays

• Knowledge of mammalian cell culture systems and 3D cell cultures (organoids)

• Expertise in software such as R, KNIME or Python

• An independent, reliable and goal-oriented work style

• You are not afraid to take on responsibility, tackle new tasks and independently acquire the necessary expertise

• You have an open and communicative personality and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment

• Good oral and written proficiency in German and English is required: You must be fluent in everyday use of both languages

Our offer

• A challenging and varied role in the field of cutting-edge international research

• Progressive working conditions, an open work environment, excellent opportunities for professional development and a modern workplace in St. Gallen

• Initial 2-year fixed-term position—with the possibility of extension

• Flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, knowledge exchange, working together in a team

• Ideal starting date: 1 November 2026 or upon agreement

We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, reporting on 1 - 2 representative tasks / experiences supporting your skills (see application process), CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. descriptionByLocale.en:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

System-Engineer Cell Culture Automation 80 - 100%

The Nanomaterials in Health department at Empa St. Gallen is a highly motivated team of biologists, chemists and bioinformaticians. Our aim is understanding and controlling the interactions between (nano)materials and biological systems. To this end, we develop practical, clinically and diagnostically relevant cell-based models such as co-cultures and organoids.

Your tasks

As a specialist in cell culture automation, you will be responsible for the end-to-end development and maintenance of complex cell cultures, from concept to implementation. Specifically, this includes:
• Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to develop concepts for automating complex cell culture processes using robotics

• Conduct needs analyses to define the required system specifications and functional requirements

• Support the Laboratory Head in evaluating, comparing and selecting suitable robotic systems and assist throughout the procurement process

• Lead the implementation of the selected system, including its configuration and the programming of automated workflows and procedures

Your profile

• Master’s degree in life sciences, engineering, or equivalent education

• At least 3 years of professional experience in programming and operating laboratory automation and liquid-handling systems, as well as in related quality management

• Experience in adapting and optimizing cell-based and in vitro assays

• Knowledge of mammalian cell culture systems and 3D cell cultures (organoids)

• Expertise in software such as R, KNIME or Python

• An independent, reliable and goal-oriented work style

• You are not afraid to take on responsibility, tackle new tasks and independently acquire the necessary expertise

• You have an open and communicative personality and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment

• Good oral and written proficiency in German and English is required: You must be fluent in everyday use of both languages

Our offer

• A challenging and varied role in the field of cutting-edge international research

• Progressive working conditions, an open work environment, excellent opportunities for professional development and a modern workplace in St. Gallen

• Initial 2-year fixed-term position—with the possibility of extension

• Flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, knowledge exchange, working together in a team

• Ideal starting date: 1 November 2026 or upon agreement

We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, reporting on 1 - 2 representative tasks / experiences supporting your skills (see application process), CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

- Responsabilità per il funzionamento sicuro, economico e senza problemi dell'infrastruttura elettrica

- Esperienza nella conduzione e manutenzione di impianti di media e bassa tensione
- Divertiti a gestire i dipendenti e a formare gli studenti

- Mentalità pratica e piacere di essere coinvolti personalmente nel lavoro tecnico

Ti offriamo:

- Una posizione di leadership responsabile con grande spazio per la creatività
- Strutture tecniche e sfide entusiasmanti
- Una squadra motivata e collegiale
- Interessanti opportunità di formazione continua e di sviluppo

jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

Postdoctoral Researcher in Ceramic Proton Conductors and Semiconductor Photoelectrochemistry

Empa’s Laboratory for High Performance Ceramics addresses fundamental questions in electrochemical energy conversion and storage by combining advanced materials synthesis with synchrotron radiation, neutron scattering, spectroscopy and electroanalytical methods. A major research direction is the development of physical methods and models for the description of cooperative effects in charge transport, proton dynamics and electrochemical conversion in solids and at electrochemical interfaces.

Your tasks

The research focuses on experimental investigations and theory building of charge and ion transport processes in functional materials.
• Synthesis and processing of ceramic proton conductors, solid electrolytes and semiconductor photoelectrodes

• Structural characterization using X-ray and neutron diffraction

• Investigation of ionic transport by impedance spectroscopy and complementary electrochemical methods

• Determination of electronic, vibrational and vibronic structure using synchrotron- and neutron-based spectroscopic techniques

• Development and validation of quantitative physical models describing charge transport, proton dynamics and electrochemical conversion

• Writing peer reviewed publications and research proposals

Your profile

We are looking for a highly motivated scientist who thrives in a competitive, high-intensity research environment. The ideal candidate is an experimentalist holding a PhD in physics, chemistry or materials science, with a strong background in solid-state electrochemistry and/or semiconductor photoelectrochemistry. A genuine interest in the fundamental theories of condensed matter physics and physical chemistry, demonstrated through a convincing publication record, is essential.
 As our research addresses fundamental scientific questions beyond the state of the art, we seek an individual with outstanding problem-solving abilities, strong experimental and technical skills, excellent scientific writing skills, and the ability to synthesize concepts across different disciplines. Experience in electrochemistry, solid-state chemistry, neutron or synchrotron techniques, spectroscopy, or related methods will be considered an advantage.

The successful candidate is expected to work with low supervision in the laboratory while contributing actively to an international collaborative research environment through effective communication and teamwork.

Our offer

You will join the Laboratory for High Performance Ceramics at Empa, working directly with the Principal Investigator on internationally funded research projects in solid-state ionics and semiconductor photoelectrochemistry. The position offers a unique opportunity to pursue fundamental materials research in close collaboration with leading international research groups.
 The laboratory provides a modern experimental environment for ceramic processing, electrochemical and photoelectrochemical characterization, optical spectroscopy, and structural analysis. A broad range of instrumentation is available, including UV–Vis, Raman and impedance spectroscopy, X-ray diffraction, and complementary analytical techniques.

The projects provide access to neutron and synchrotron facilities and are embedded in long-standing international collaborations with leading scientists and research institutions. The successful candidate will participate in experiments at large-scale research facilities and contribute to interdisciplinary research at the forefront of energy materials science.

We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La scienza e la tecnologia dei materiali sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca all'avanguardia, i circa 1.100 dipendenti di Empa forniscono contributi essenziali al benessere della società per un futuro che valga la pena vivere. Empa è un'istituzione di ricerca del dominio ETH.

Ricercatore Postdottorando in Conduttori Protonici Ceramici e Fotoelettrochimia dei Semiconduttori

Il Laboratorio per Ceramiche ad Alte Prestazioni di Empa affronta questioni fondamentali nella conversione e nello stoccaggio dell'energia elettrochimica combinando la sintesi avanzata di materiali con radiazione di sincrotrone, scattering neutronico, spettroscopia e metodi elettroanalitici. Una direzione di ricerca principale è lo sviluppo di metodi fisici e modelli per la descrizione degli effetti cooperativi nel trasporto di carica, nella dinamica protonica e nella conversione elettrochimica nei solidi e alle interfacce elettrochimiche.

Responsabilità

- La ricerca si concentra su indagini sperimentali e costruzione di teorie dei processi di trasporto di carica e ioni nei materiali funzionali.
- Sintesi e lavorazione di conduttori protonici ceramici, elettroliti solidi e fotoelettrodi semiconduttori
- Caratterizzazione strutturale mediante diffrazione a raggi X e neutroni
- Indagine del trasporto ionico mediante spettroscopia di impedenza e metodi elettrochimici complementari
- Determinazione della struttura elettronica, vibrazionale e vibronica utilizzando tecniche spettroscopiche basate su sincrotrone e neutroni
- Sviluppo e validazione di modelli fisici quantitativi che descrivono il trasporto di carica, la dinamica protonica e la conversione elettrochimica
- Redazione di pubblicazioni sottoposte a revisione paritaria e proposte di ricerca

Requisiti

- Cerchiamo uno scienziato altamente motivato che prosperi in un ambiente di ricerca competitivo e ad alta intensità.
- Il candidato ideale è uno sperimentalista con dottorato in fisica, chimica o scienza dei materiali, con una solida formazione in elettrochimica dello stato solido e/o fotoelettrochimia dei semiconduttori.
- Un genuino interesse per le teorie fondamentali della fisica della materia condensata e della chimica fisica, dimostrato attraverso un convincente curriculum di pubblicazioni, è essenziale.
- Poiché la nostra ricerca affronta questioni scientifiche fondamentali oltre lo stato dell'arte, cerchiamo un individuo con eccezionali capacità di risoluzione dei problemi, forti competenze sperimentali e tecniche, eccellenti competenze di scrittura scientifica e la capacità di sintetizzare concetti tra diverse discipline.
- L'esperienza in elettrochimica, chimica dello stato solido, tecniche neutroniche o di sincrotrone, spettroscopia o metodi correlati sarà considerata un vantaggio.
- Il candidato selezionato dovrebbe lavorare con bassa supervisione in laboratorio mentre contribuisce attivamente a un ambiente di ricerca collaborativa internazionale attraverso una comunicazione efficace e il lavoro di squadra.

Ciò che offriamo

- Ti unirai al Laboratorio per Ceramiche ad Alte Prestazioni presso Empa, lavorando direttamente con l'Investigatore Principale su progetti di ricerca finanziati internazionalmente in ionica dello stato solido e fotoelettrochimia dei semiconduttori.
- La posizione offre un'opportunità unica di perseguire ricerca fondamentale su materiali in stretta collaborazione con i principali gruppi di ricerca internazionali.
- Il laboratorio fornisce un moderno ambiente sperimentale per la lavorazione di ceramiche, la caratterizzazione elettrochimica e fotoelettrochimia, la spettroscopia ottica e l'analisi strutturale.
- È disponibile un'ampia gamma di strumentazione, inclusa spettroscopia UV-Vis, Raman e di impedenza, diffrazione a raggi X e tecniche analitiche complementari.
- I progetti forniscono accesso a strutture neutroniche e di sincrotrone e sono integrati in collaborazioni internazionali di lunga data con scienziati e istituzioni di ricerca di primo piano.
- Il candidato selezionato parteciperà a esperimenti presso strutture di ricerca su larga scala e contribuirà a ricerche interdisciplinari all'avanguardia della scienza dei materiali per l'energia.
- Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Accogliamo tutti coloro che sono interessati ad attività innovative, sostenibili e significative - è questo che conta.

Contatti

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda online completa, inclusa una lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati, diplomi e i dettagli di contatto di due persone di riferimento. Si prega di inviare questi esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale di lavoro. Le domande via e-mail e per posta non saranno considerate.

Postdoktorand(in) in Keramischen Protonenleitern und Halbleiter-Photoelektrochemie

Das Laboratorium für Hochleistungskeramik von Empa befasst sich mit grundlegenden Fragen der elektrochemischen Energieumwandlung und -speicherung, indem es fortgeschrittene Materialsynthese mit Synchrotronstrahlung, Neutronenstreuung, Spektroskopie und elektrochemischen Analysemethoden verbindet. Eine Hauptforschungsrichtung ist die Entwicklung physikalischer Methoden und Modelle zur Beschreibung kooperativer Effekte im Ladungstransport, in der Protonendynamik und in der elektrochemischen Umwandlung in Festkörpern und an elektrochemischen Grenzflächen.

- Die Forschung konzentriert sich auf experimentelle Untersuchungen und Theorieentwicklung von Ladungs- und Ionentransportprozessen in Funktionsmaterialien.
- Synthese und Verarbeitung von keramischen Protonenleitern, Festelektrolyten und Halbleiter-Photoelektroden
- Strukturelle Charakterisierung mittels Röntgen- und Neutronendiffraktion
- Untersuchung des Ionentransports durch Impedanzspektroskopie und ergänzende elektrochemische Methoden
- Bestimmung der elektronischen, Schwingungs- und Schwingungsstruktur unter Verwendung von Synchrotron- und Neutron-basierten Spektroskopieverfahren
- Entwicklung und Validierung quantitativer physikalischer Modelle, die Ladungstransport, Protonendynamik und elektrochemische Umwandlung beschreiben
- Verfassen von begutachteten Veröffentlichungen und Forschungsanträgen

- Ein echtes Interesse an den Grundlagentheorien der Festkörperphysik und physikalischen Chemie, das durch eine überzeugende Publikationsbilanz demonstriert wird, ist unerlässlich.
- Da unsere Forschung grundlegende wissenschaftliche Fragen jenseits des aktuellen Forschungsstands behandelt, suchen wir eine Person mit herausragenden Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, starken experimentellen und technischen Fähigkeiten, exzellenten wissenschaftlichen Schreibfähigkeiten und der Fähigkeit, Konzepte über verschiedene Disziplinen hinweg zu synthetisieren.
- Erfahrung in Elektrochemie, Festkörperchemie, Neutronen- oder Synchrotrrontechniken, Spektroskopie oder verwandten Methoden wird als Vorteil betrachtet.
- Der/Die erfolgreiche Kandidat(in) sollte mit wenig Aufsicht im Labor arbeiten und gleichzeitig aktiv zu einer internationalen kooperativen Forschungsumgebung durch effektive Kommunikation und Teamarbeit beitragen.

Das bieten wir

- Sie werden sich dem Laboratorium für Hochleistungskeramik bei Empa anschließen und direkt mit dem Hauptforscher an international finanzierten Forschungsprojekten in Festkörperionica und Halbleiter-Photoelektrochemie arbeiten.
- Die Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, grundlegende Materialforschung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit führenden internationalen Forschungsgruppen zu betreiben.
- Das Laboratorium bietet eine moderne experimentelle Umgebung für die Keramikverarbeitung, elektrochemische und photoelektrochemische Charakterisierung, optische Spektroskopie und Strukturanalyse.
- Ein breites Spektrum an Instrumentationen ist verfügbar, einschließlich UV-Vis-, Raman- und Impedanzspektroskopie, Röntgendiffraktion und ergänzende analytische Techniken.
- Die Projekte bieten Zugang zu Neutronen- und Synchrotronanlagen und sind in langfristige internationale Zusammenarbeit mit führenden Wissenschaftlern und Forschungsinstitutionen eingebunden.
- Der/Die erfolgreiche Kandidat(in) wird an Experimenten in großen Forschungseinrichtungen teilnehmen und zu interdisziplinärer Forschung an der Spitze der Energiematerialforschung beitragen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
La science et la technologie des matériaux sont notre passion. Avec nos recherches de pointe, environ 1 100 employés d'Empa apportent des contributions essentielles au bien-être de la société pour un avenir qui vaut la peine d'être vécu. Empa est une institution de recherche du domaine de l'ETH.

Chercheur(se) Postdoctoral(e) en Conducteurs Protoniques Céramiques et Photoélectrochimie des Semiconducteurs

Le Laboratoire pour les Céramiques Haute Performance d'Empa aborde des questions fondamentales en matière de conversion et de stockage d'énergie électrochimique en combinant la synthèse avancée de matériaux avec le rayonnement synchrotron, la diffusion de neutrons, la spectroscopie et les méthodes électroanalytiques. Une orientation majeure de la recherche est le développement de méthodes physiques et de modèles pour la description des effets coopératifs dans le transport de charge, la dynamique des protons et la conversion électrochimique dans les solides et aux interfaces électrochimiques.

Responsabilités

- La recherche se concentre sur les investigations expérimentales et la construction de théories des processus de transport de charge et d'ions dans les matériaux fonctionnels.
- Synthèse et traitement des conducteurs protoniques céramiques, électrolytes solides et photoélectrodes semiconducteurs
- Caractérisation structurale par diffraction aux rayons X et aux neutrons
- Investigation du transport ionique par spectroscopie d'impédance et méthodes électrochimiques complémentaires
- Détermination de la structure électronique, vibratoire et vibronique en utilisant les techniques spectroscopiques basées sur synchrotron et neutrons
- Développement et validation de modèles physiques quantitatifs décrivant le transport de charge, la dynamique des protons et la conversion électrochimique
- Rédaction de publications évaluées par les pairs et de propositions de recherche

Exigences

- Nous recherchons un scientifique hautement motivé qui s'épanouit dans un environnement de recherche compétitif et intensif.
- Le/la candidat(e) idéal(e) est un(e) expérimentaliste titulaire d'un doctorat en physique, chimie ou science des matériaux, ayant une solide formation en électrochimie de l'état solide et/ou photoélectrochimie des semiconducteurs.
- Un véritable intérêt pour les théories fondamentales de la physique de la matière condensée et de la chimie physique, démontré par un dossier de publication convaincant, est essentiel.
- Comme notre recherche aborde des questions scientifiques fondamentales au-delà de l'état de l'art, nous recherchons un individu ayant des capacités exceptionnelles de résolution de problèmes, de fortes compétences expérimentales et techniques, d'excellentes compétences en rédaction scientifique et la capacité à synthétiser les concepts entre différentes disciplines.
- L'expérience en électrochimie, chimie de l'état solide, techniques de neutrons ou synchrotron, spectroscopie ou méthodes connexes sera considérée comme un avantage.
- Le/la candidat(e) retenu(e) devrait travailler avec une supervision minimale au laboratoire tout en contribuant activement à un environnement de recherche collaborative international par une communication efficace et un travail d'équipe.

Ce que nous offrons

- Vous rejoindrez le Laboratoire pour les Céramiques Haute Performance chez Empa, travaillant directement avec l'Investigateur Principal sur des projets de recherche financés au niveau international en ionique de l'état solide et photoélectrochimie des semiconducteurs.
- Le poste offre une opportunité unique de mener des recherches fondamentales sur les matériaux en étroite collaboration avec les principaux groupes de recherche internationaux.
- Le laboratoire fournit un environnement expérimental moderne pour le traitement des céramiques, la caractérisation électrochimique et photoélectrochimique, la spectroscopie optique et l'analyse structurale.
- Un large éventail d'instrumentation est disponible, incluant la spectroscopie UV-Vis, Raman et d'impédance, la diffraction aux rayons X et les techniques analytiques complémentaires.
- Les projets offrent un accès aux installations de neutrons et synchrotron et sont intégrés dans des collaborations internationales de longue date avec des scientifiques éminents et des institutions de recherche.
- Le/la candidat(e) retenu(e) participera aux expériences dans les grandes installations de recherche et contribuera à la recherche interdisciplinaire à l'avant-garde de la science des matériaux pour l'énergie.

Lernende/r Elektroinstallateur/in (a)

Für August 2027 bieten wir dir in der Abteilung Immobilien einen anspruchsvollen Ausbildungsplatz in einem faszinierenden Forschungsumfeld.

Ihre Aufgaben

An einem ETH Forschungsinstitut tätig zu sein, bringt viel Abwechslung in den Berufsalltag. Die vielseitigen und spannenden Aufgaben in unserer Infrastruktur auf dem Campus Dübendorf in einem internationalen Umfeld garantieren Jugendlichen eine vielseitige Lehre.

Daneben bist du an der Betreuung unserer diversen Kommunikations- und Signalnetze mitbeteiligt und sorgst für die Behebung von Störungen.

Die Sekundarschule ist bald Geschichte und du schliesst diese mit guten Leistungen in Mathematik, Geometrie und Physik ab. Dein Interesse an Technik und Elektrotechnik, gepaart mit deinem Sinn für praktische und theoretische Zusammenhänge unterstützen dich in deiner Lehrzeit. Du bringst eine rasche Auffassungsgabe sowie ein gutes Gedächtnis mit, magst manuelles Arbeiten und bist ausdauernd. descriptionByLocale.it:
La scienza e la tecnologia materiali sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca di alto livello, i circa 1.100 dipendenti di Empa contribuiscono in modo decisivo al benessere della società per un futuro degno di essere vissuto. Empa è un istituto di ricerca della divisione ETH.

Trainer/elettro-installer (a)

Per l'agosto 2027, vi offriamo un luogo di formazione impegnativo nel dipartimento Immobiliare in un ambiente di ricerca affascinante.

I tuoi compiti

Lavorare in un istituto di ricerca ETH porta molte varietà al lavoro quotidiano. Il versatile e le attività emozionanti nella nostra infrastruttura nel campus di Dübendorf in un ambiente internazionale garantiscono ai giovani un insegnamento di laurea. Vicino alla ricerca e allo sviluppo fai parte del nostro team di supporto e aiuta a mantenere l'infrastruttura in tutti gli edifici del campus. Con un apprendistato come elettroinstaller si avvia il collegamento dalle distribuzioni attraverso la misurazione e il passaggio punti per l'utente di energia.

Siete anche coinvolti nel supporto delle nostre varie reti di comunicazione e di segnale e siete responsabili della correzione dei malfunzionamenti.

Il tuo profilo

La scuola secondaria è presto storia e la completi con buoni risultati in matematica, geometria e fisica. Il tuo interesse per l'ingegneria e l'ingegneria elettrica, insieme al tuo senso di connessioni pratiche e teoriche, ti supportano nel tuo tempo di insegnamento. Porti una comprensione rapida e una buona memoria, come il lavoro manuale e sono persistenti. Apprezziamo anche la cura e l'affidabilità, così come la responsabilità e il lavoro di coscienza. Non da ultimo, una normale resistenza al colore è un must.

La nostra offerta

• Un corso di formazione di base per apparecchiature elettriche e possibilità di collegamento per apparecchiature e macchine

• Impari a creare connessioni dalle distribuzioni attraverso la misurazione e il passaggio dei punti al consumo energetico e poi puoi risolvere i guasti da solo

• Un'officina elettrica equipaggiata con strumenti e attrezzature moderne

• Formatori professionali impegnati e qualificati

• Frequenta la scuola professionale di Wetzikon

• La visita del BMS è sostenuta

Offriamo una formazione emozionante con la tecnologia più moderna. Empa è un ambiente di ricerca vivace e innovativo con un tocco internazionale e condizioni di lavoro eccellenti nella Agglomeration Zurigo.

"a" sta per "tutti" nelle nostre liste di lavoro. Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Accogliamo tutte le persone che sono in vena di attività innovative, sostenibili e soleggiate.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua domanda online completa, comprese lettere motivazionali, CV e certificati. Ti preghiamo di inviarli esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale applicativo. Le domande per e-mail e per posta non saranno prese in considerazione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Material science and technology are our passion. With our top-level research, the approximately 1,100 employees of Empa make a decisive contribution to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH division.

Trainer/electro-installer (a)

For August 2027, we offer you a challenging training place in the Real Estate department in a fascinating research environment.

Your tasks

Working at an ETH research institute brings a lot of variety to everyday work. The versatile and exciting tasks in our infrastructure on the Dübendorf campus in an international environment guarantee young people a versatile teaching. Close to research and development you are part of our support team and help to maintain the infrastructure in all buildings on the campus. With an apprenticeship as an electroinstaller you start the connection from distributions through measuring and switching points to the energy user.

You are also involved in the support of our various communication and signal networks and are responsible for the correction of malfunctions.

Your profile

The secondary school is soon history and you complete it with good achievements in mathematics, geometry and physics. Your interest in engineering and electrical engineering, coupled with your sense of practical and theoretical connections, support you in your teaching time. You bring a quick understanding and a good memory, like manual work and are persistent. We also appreciate care and reliability as well as responsibility and conscientious work. Not least, a normal colour-proofness is a must.

Our offer

• A versatile basic training for electrical equipment and connection options for equipment and machines

• You learn to create connections from distributions through measurement and switching points to the energy consumption and can then fix faults by yourself

• A top equipped electric workshop with modern tools and equipment

• Committed and qualified professional trainers

• You are attending the vocational school in Wetzikon

• The visit of the BMS is supported

We offer an exciting training with the most modern technology. Empa is a vibrant and innovative research environment with an international flair and excellent employment conditions in the Agglomeration Zurich.

"a" stands for "all" in our job listings. We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are in the mood for innovative, sustainable and sun-drenched activities – that's all that counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including motivational letters, CV and certificates. Please submit them exclusively via our application portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be taken into account.

Eine vielseitige und praxisnahe Berufsbildung ist uns besonders wichtig. Bei uns lernst du nicht nur dein Handwerk, sondern arbeitest aktiv in einem innovativen Forschungsumfeld. Für eine erfolgreiche Berufslehre an der Empa zählen Motivation, Eigeninitiative und Flexibilität.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi siamo

La scienza e la tecnologia dei materiali sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca all'avanguardia, i circa 1.100 collaboratori dell'Empa danno un contributo decisivo al benessere della società e ad un futuro degno di essere vissuto. L'Empa è un istituto di ricerca del settore dei PF.

Apprendista assistente di laboratorio EFZ con specializzazione nel settore tessile (a)

Per noi è particolarmente importante una formazione professionale versatile e pratica. Con noi non solo impari il tuo mestiere, ma lavori anche attivamente in un ambiente di ricerca innovativo. Un apprendistato di successo all'Empa richiede motivazione, iniziativa e flessibilità.

Indipendenza, senso di responsabilità, creatività e pensiero in rete ti accompagneranno durante tutta la tua formazione. Con il nostro programma di supporto interno “Saphir” vi forniamo ulteriore supporto mirato nel vostro sviluppo. Se sei curioso, ti piace lavorare sulle tecnologie del futuro e trovi interessante la ricerca, non vediamo l'ora di conoscerti.

Compiti

- I tecnici di laboratorio EFZ Textil imparano non solo come maneggiare in sicurezza i prodotti chimici, ma anche i processi tecnici e di tintura.
- I corsi introduttivi esterni specifici per il settore chimico e tessile supportano il trasferimento di conoscenze durante la formazione.
- Lavori su progetti di ricerca e impari a pianificare e realizzare esperimenti in laboratorio e valutare i risultati.
- La registrazione degli esperimenti è una parte centrale del lavoro quotidiano.
- Oltre alla formazione interna, frequenterai il Centro commerciale di formazione professionale e perfezionamento di San Gallo (GBS).

Requisiti

- Hai conseguito il diploma di scuola secondaria superiore con buoni risultati in matematica, fisica, chimica e inglese.
- Hai una buona visione dei colori.
- Hai la volontà di imparare ed esibirti.
- Per te è molto importante pensare in rete e un modo di lavorare preciso e affidabile.
- Ti piace lavorare al PC e hai molta perseveranza per gli esperimenti che non funzionano subito.

Offriamo

- Offriamo una formazione interessante, un ambiente di lavoro moderno e ottime condizioni di lavoro.
- Con noi hai l'opportunità di acquisire una vasta gamma di conoscenze.
- L'Empa è un ambiente di ricerca vivace e innovativo con un tocco internazionale.
- Puoi trovare ulteriori informazioni sull'insegnamento dell'Empa nella nostra scheda informativa e sulla nostra homepage.

Nei nostri annunci di lavoro “a” sta per “all”. Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Diamo il benvenuto a tutte le persone interessate ad attività innovative, sostenibili e significative: questo è tutto ciò che conta.

Contatto

Saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura online completa, inclusa una lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati, test della cabina di segnalazione e dettagli di contatto per due referenze. Si prega di inviare questi documenti esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale di candidatura. Non verranno prese in considerazione candidature inviate via e-mail o posta.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About us

Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's approximately 1,100 employees make crucial contributions to the well-being of society and to a future worth living. Empa is a research institution in the ETH domain.

Apprentice laboratory assistant EFZ specializing in textiles (a)

Versatile and practical vocational training is particularly important to us. With us you not only learn your craft, but also work actively in an innovative research environment. A successful apprenticeship at Empa requires motivation, initiative and flexibility.

Independence, a sense of responsibility, creativity and networked thinking accompany you throughout your entire training. With our internal “Saphir” support program, we provide you with additional targeted support in your development. If you are curious, enjoy working on future technologies and find research exciting, we look forward to getting to know you.

Tasks

- EFZ Textil laboratory technicians learn not only how to safely handle chemicals, but also technical and dyeing processes.
- External chemical and textile-specific introductory courses support the transfer of knowledge during your training.
- You work on research projects and learn to plan and carry out experiments in the laboratory and evaluate the results.
- Recording experiments is a central part of daily work.
